title: Part 5: Launch Day & Live Event
author: J.W.
excerpt: Sometimes you build something complex and realize the simple version was better all along. After constructing the entire Cinematic Engine, I made the strategic call to restore the original landing page—the one with the CRT TV and sliding tile puzzle. December 12th needed to feel like a reveal, not a replacement. Five minutes before Phase 1 launch, I was hunting performance bottlenecks with terminal open and coffee in hand. The transmission was about to begin.
